name: Thoughts
description: Every conversation with Webbee, on every surface, kept and reachable — search back through past threads, continue an older one, rename or pin what matters, and start fresh without losing what came before.

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Permanently erase ONE conversation and everything said in it. This cannot be undone. If it is the live thread, the chat record is cleared too and a fresh thread opens in its place, so nothing keeps writing into a deleted conversation. Always confirm which thread with the user first.

conversation_id.description: Which thread to delete for good — its id from list_conversations. This cannot be undone, so it must be an id the user actually chose, never one inferred from a description.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

return_schema.description: What a delete actually did — stated, not assumed.

deleted.description: The thread id that is now gone
deleted.title: Deleted

was_live.description: Whether it was the live conversation
was_live.title: Was Live

replacement_id.description: The fresh thread opened in its place, if any
replacement_id.title: Replacement Id

return_schema.title: DeletedRecord

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the user's past conversations with Webbee — every thread from every surface (panel, Telegram, terminal), pinned first then newest, marking which one is live right now. Use this FIRST whenever the user refers to something you talked about before, instead of answering from memory.

limit.description: How many threads to return (newest/pinned first).
limit.title: Limit

include_archived.description: Also list threads the user archived out of the way.
include_archived.title: Include Archived

query.description: Optional filter — matches the thread's title or the preview of its last message, case-insensitive. Use it when the user describes a conversation instead of naming it ('the one about billing').
query.title: Query

id.description: Thread id — pass this to read/continue/rename/delete
id.title: Id

title.description: Its name; empty until it has earned one
title.title: Title

updated.description: How long ago it was last touched
updated.title: Updated

live.description: True for the one every surface is reading now
live.title: Live

pinned.description: Kept at the top of the list
pinned.title: Pinned

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read what was actually said in one conversation — its messages, oldest first, with who said what and when. Pass a thread id from list_conversations, or leave it empty to read the live conversation.

conversation_id.description: Which thread — its id from list_conversations. Empty = the live conversation (the one every surface is reading right now).
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

limit.description: How many messages to return, oldest-first.
limit.title: Limit

return_schema.description: One message inside a thread, oldest-first.

role.description: who said it — user or assistant
role.title: Role

surface.description: Where it was said, when the platform recorded one
surface.title: Surface

return_schema.title: MessageRecord

tools.name: continue_conversation
tools.description: Walk back into an earlier conversation and make it the live one, so the next thing said continues THAT thread on every surface. The current conversation is archived first, never lost. Use when the user wants to pick up something from before — list_conversations first to get the id.

conversation_id.description: Which thread to make live — its id from list_conversations. Never guess this: list first if the user described it in words.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

return_schema.description: The thread that is live after a switch, a start, or a rename.

conversation_id.description: The thread this call acted on
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

note.description: What happened to the previous thread
note.title: Note

return_schema.title: SwitchedRecord

tools.name: new_conversation
tools.description: Start a fresh conversation thread. The current one is archived first and stays readable. Use when the user wants a clean slate or is clearly changing subject and asks to start over.

title.description: Optional name for the new thread. Leave empty and it names itself from the first thing said in it.
title.title: Title

return_schema.description: The thread that is live after a switch, a start, or a rename.

conversation_id.description: The thread this call acted on
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

note.description: What happened to the previous thread
note.title: Note

return_schema.title: SwitchedRecord

tools.name: rename_conversation
tools.description: Give a conversation a name of the user's choosing. A hand-picked title is kept as-is and never overwritten by the automatic namer afterwards.

conversation_id.description: Which thread to rename — its id from list_conversations.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

title.description: The new name. A hand-written name is final: the automatic namer stops touching this thread once a person has named it.
title.title: Title

return_schema.description: The thread that is live after a switch, a start, or a rename.

conversation_id.description: The thread this call acted on
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

note.description: What happened to the previous thread
note.title: Note

return_schema.title: SwitchedRecord
